## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Closes # (issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] DevOps / CI/CD pipeline enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Acceptance & Testing Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass locally (`mvn test`)
- [ ] Selenium end-to-end tests pass (`mvn test -Dtest=*Selenium*`)
- [ ] Docker image builds cleanly (`docker build -t marathon-portal .`)
- [ ] Branch naming convention conforms to policy (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`)
